name: decision-seed
description: Default small suite for the decision-eval-suite: a handful of decision/contract cases across the quality spectrum, for a quick smoke run of the judge + gate. Select with EVAL_SUITE=decision-seed (the default 'seed' is a CODE suite — decision runs must set EVAL_SUITE to a decision-* suite).
scale: Each dimension is scored 1-5 by the judge (5 = excellent, 1 = absent/broken).
